requirement: The WO vision pixel fixture draws its text as glyph outlines, so it reads on a web host with no system fonts

oracle.ref: PR #1642 (fix); fix evidence: Dev, 23/10/2026: a vision pixel test answered that the code and bottom sentence 'render as placeholder boxes'; the dev web container has no /usr/share/fonts, and its sharp renders the old fixture text as boxes.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. The fixture SVG has no <text> and no font-family; every nonce and expected-text character has a glyph and an unknown one throws. The rendered PNG has ink in the nonce and bottom-text areas, two nonces draw different pixels, and an empty fontconfig renders the same bytes. VISION_TEST_VERSION is pixel-layout-ocr/2, so proofs made with the old image no longer count.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
